newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps rates Mexico Samarai bond BB.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps rates Mexico Samarai bond BB.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday that it assigned a BB foreign currency rating to Mexico's 70 billion yen Samarai bond issue.
The six-year bonds have a five percent coupon.
D&P said its positive view of Mexico's economy and credit standing underpinned the rating.

Mexico's financial position is supported by strong foreign direct investment, which should help the economy's recover, the agency said. The ailing financial sector remained a concern, but has benefitted from improving fundamentals, as well as a restructuring program, D&P said.
International capital flows, however, will continue to be crucial in complementing Mexico's low domestic savings, Duff and Phelps said.
